description: Resolve the PTR record for any IPv4 or IPv6 address — the hostname the IP's owner configured in reverse DNS. Reveals hosting providers, mail-server identities and corporate naming; a missing PTR on a mail source is also a deliverability red flag. Use this when an agent needs to what hostname claims this IP address?. x402 price $0.02/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
name: security_reverse_dns
title: Reverse DNS (PTR) Lookup
